options.name: annotations
options.description: Custom metadata fields with fewer restrictions, as key/value pairs. These are preserved by Sensu but not accessible as tokens or identifiers, and are mainly intended for use with external tools.

options.name: auth
options.description: Authentication parameters. Can define each of them with ENV as well.

options.name: check_hooks
options.description: A mapping of response codes to hooks which will be run by the agent when that code is returned. Note that the structure of this parameter is a bit different from the one described at U(https://docs.sensu.io/sensu-go/latest/reference/checks/#check-hooks-attribute). See check hooks example below for more information on exact mapping structure.

options.name: command
options.description: Check command to run. Required if I(state) is C(present).

options.name: cron
options.description: Schedule check requests using crontab syntax. Cannot be used when I(interval) option is used.

options.name: env_vars
options.description: A mapping of environment variable names and values to use with command execution.

options.name: handlers
options.description: List of handlers which receive check results.

options.name: high_flap_threshold
options.description: High flap threshold.

options.name: interval
options.description: Check request interval. Cannot be used when I(cron) option is used.

options.name: labels
options.description: Custom metadata fields that can be accessed within Sensu, as key/value pairs.

options.name: low_flap_threshold
options.description: Low flap threshold.

options.name: name
options.description: The Sensu resource's name. This name (in combination with the namespace where applicable) uniquely identifies the resource that Ansible operates on. If the resource with selected name already exists, Ansible module will update it to match the specification in the task. Consult the I(name) metadata attribute specification in the upstream docs on U(https://docs.sensu.io/sensu-go/latest/reference/) for more details about valid names and other restrictions.

options.name: namespace
options.description: RBAC namespace to operate in. If this is not set the value of the SENSU_NAMESPACE environment variable will be used.

options.name: output_metric_format
options.description: Enable parsing of metrics in the specified format from this check's output.

options.name: output_metric_handlers
options.description: List of handlers which receive check results. I'm not sure why this exists.

options.name: proxy_entity_name
options.description: Entity name to associate this check with instead of the agent it ran on.

options.name: proxy_requests
options.description: Allows you to assign the check to run for multiple entities according to their entity_attributes.

options.name: publish
options.description: Enables or disables scheduled publication of check requests.

options.name: round_robin
options.description: An array of environment variables to use with command execution.

options.name: runtime_assets
options.description: List of runtime assets required to run the check.

options.name: secrets
options.description: List of secrets that are available to the command.

options.name: state
options.description: Target state of the Sensu object.

options.name: stdin
options.description: Enables writing of serialized JSON data to the check command's stdin. Only usable with checks written specifically for Sensu Go.

options.name: subscriptions
options.description: List of subscriptions which receive check requests. Required if I(state) is C(present).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Check execution timeout.

options.name: ttl
options.description: Amount of time after which a check result is considered stale.
